slides.visual_text: A magazine cover in a red frame: TIME, January 13, 1986, $1.95. Headline: FARE GAMES, Flying Has Never Been Cheaper. A smiling man in a suit and tie fills the cover, with many small figures flying through a cloudy sky behind him. Caption at the bottom right: People Express Chairman Donald Burr. A corner banner reads: TERRORISM, Targeting the Mass Murderers.

Timeline titled DONALD BURR, A BACKGROUND STORY, drawn as an arrow with five dots: 1965 Joined National Aviation Corporation; 1972 Became President; 1973 Joined Texas International Airlines; 1979 President; 1980 Resigned and set off to Found PE.

slides.title: Changes seen in Donald Burr
slides.text:

Became overwhelmed with work and accountability.
Had no time to communicate with employees.
Grievances were ignored or just left unresolved.
Donald Burr became unavailable for any meetings.
Donald Burr develops an intolerance for criticism.

slides.title: The last straw.
slides.text:
The last straw.
Donald Burr started policing
employees.
His most loyal employee Ms.
Hellinger expresses her true opinion of what was happening to her Boss.
Donald Burr fires her in retaliation.
Employees lose morale and
motivation.
Labour unrest and lack of
productivity.
People Express goes into Bankruptcy.

slides.text:
Did Burr modify his Mission
accordingly ?
► Burr was so confident of his original mission that he felt
confident to use it on all business models.
► But in practice this assumption failed completely and the
aggregated group of employees from varying work cultures just
couldn’t find a common rhythm. The employee attitude and
satisfaction took a nose dive.
► Burr became overwhelmed with work and accountability and
ultimately lost his connect with his vision and mission. He
was not wise enough to redesign a new mission.
► He went into a firefighting mode and starting policing his
employee.
► Far from being a fatherly employer Donald Burr became a
unkind and unjust employer.

slides.text:
Did he communicate the
need to change?
► Change is very stressful and induces anxiety and
resistance.
► Communicating the need for change and the
most optimum way to change is critical in
managing change.
► Orientation and training programs have a great
role to play in this connection.
► With the right facilitation it is always possible to
manage change and succeed in implementing the
required transformation.
